title: 高三单遍：打印文件与行程变化
source_notice: 参照高三山东公开读者层第一节：五独立短对话各一题三选、每段一遍、听后十秒兼作本题作答与读下一题，本节未印已解示例。网页称期中，正文为2025届第二次诊断/2024.11，原校发布未认证；题面、印出脚本和键可核，原录音缺，普通HTTP500，不绕门取文件。与高三既有两遍/已解示例模式分开，不能按年级统一复用播放次数。全部对话、问题、候选和合成音轨为原创；本机审阅可重播，不当自然语流、年级/难度等值、独立教研、学生、商用或生产通过。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段一遍，听后10秒兼作本题作答与读下一题；本组不含已解示例。审阅页面可重播。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I’ve brought you a printed copy of the report. I thought that would be easier to read.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Thank you, but could you send the file as well? The print is rather small, and I can enlarge it on my screen.

questions.stem: Why does the man want the electronic file?
options: To make the text easier to read.
To print copies for a large meeting.
questions.rationale: A：没有要求更改结论；B：print small与enlarge screen明确放大阅读；C：未提出开大会或大量打印

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I thought you were leaving on the seven o’clock train. Why are you still here?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That service has been cancelled. They’ve put me on the eight o’clock one instead. There’s no extra charge.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: At least you haven’t had to buy a more expensive ticket.

questions.stem: When will the woman now leave?
questions.rationale: A：未提六点新班次；B：七点已取消；C：改乘八点明确为新安排

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The hotel has just told us the swimming pool will be closed during our stay.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: If only we’d known that before we paid. The pool was the main reason I chose that hotel.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Shall I ask whether we can change the booking?

questions.stem: How does the man feel about the booking?
options: He regrets making it without that information.
He is delighted that the pool will be quieter.
He is indifferent to the pool being closed.
questions.rationale: A：if only已知再订与泳池为主因说明遗憾；B：关闭不能解释为安静享受，且男方明显失望；C：pool是选择主因，并同意改订，非无所谓

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Have you chosen a subject for your local radio project?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. There’s a bus driver who has worked on the same route for thirty years. I’ve arranged to ask her how the neighbourhood has changed.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That should give you a story beyond the timetable.

questions.stem: What is the woman planning to do?
options: Apply for a job driving a bus.
questions.rationale: A：她在做广播项目，非应聘驾驶；B：beyond timetable不是编新时刻表；C：arranged to ask从业三十年司机社区变化，C准确

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I can reserve the small meeting room for you, but the larger one is already booked.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: There’ll only be six of us, so the small room will be fine. Please reserve it for Thursday afternoon.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: All right. I’ll send you the confirmation shortly.

questions.stem: What does the man ask the woman to do?
options: Invite more people to the meeting.
questions.rationale: A：明确please reserve small room周四下午；B：大房间他人已订，未要求取消；C：六人适合小间，未要求加人
